texts.en:
The decoding is complete. The lattice holds records from dozens of civilisations. Every account ends identically: a farewell addressed to whoever came next, and an invitation to contribute.

However, it is now obvious that the transmissions do not terminate at the event horizon. Something on the other side has been receiving these records.

The Contract still stands. [owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName] intends to inscribe our account among theirs, as agreed. We must decide whether to honour that, or silence our transmitters and walk away.
